tasks.name: axe_at_library_qwen21
tasks.prompt: A comedic 2D anime illustration featuring the two girls from the first and second reference images inside a classic library. On the left, the rebellious blonde twin-tail demon girl from the first image wearing her gothic black-and-red outfit and bat wings is standing on a wooden chair, angrily slamming her giant black-and-red X-shaped battleaxe onto the wooden desk. On the right, the elegant terracotta-orange haired scholar girl from the second image in her Victorian dress is hugging a thick leather book tightly, sweating and looking panicked as loose papers fly into the air from the axe impact. Vibrant anime art style, expressive comedic faces, crisp lineart.
